writeup: Woot has a new Suburban 161210 heat-only RV wall thermostat in black for $10.99. Omni Outdoor Living lists the matching model 161210, a black heat-only unit reported in stock, at $49.99. Suburban RV Parts has the same mechanical-readout 161210 with 88 available at $53.99, and Dyers RV has it new with UPC 786710536793 and five or more in stock at $64.71. That is about 78 percent below Omni Outdoor Living and saves roughly $39. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
